module.purpose: Selects qualified round-robin and fixed hosts for booking, applying rescheduling, event-segment, routing, contact-owner, and fairness filters while preserving non-empty fallback host sets.
module.summary: This module orchestrates host qualification for team booking flows. It normalizes delegated calendar credentials, separates fixed hosts from round-robin hosts, and applies progressively constrained filters for rescheduling, event segments, routed members, contact ownership, and lead-threshold fairness. Every filter uses a fallback to preserve bookability, while selected results may retain broader fallback hosts for later allocation.
module.businessContext: Supports equitable and constraint-aware assignment of hosts for routed team bookings. Failure could make events unbookable, select an ineligible host, or lose calendar delegation credentials.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When normalized hosts are unavailable, the function returns fallback fixed and round-robin hosts without segment matching.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves bookability when team host normalization is unavailable.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When any host filter removes every candidate, the previous non-empty candidate set is retained.
moduleContractTests.rationale: The module explicitly guarantees that filtering never produces zero round-robin hosts.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When reschedule matching leaves exactly one round-robin host, later matching stages are skipped.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures rescheduling preference takes precedence over segment and fairness matching.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When event-segment matching leaves exactly one host and reschedule matching did not select one, that host is returned.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins segment matching as the next single-host selection stage.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When routed-team filtering yields one host and the contact owner is also the selected candidate, the contact owner is qualified and included in fallback hosts.
moduleContractTests.then: result.qualifiedRRHosts equals hostsAfterContactOwnerMatching and result.allFallbackRRHosts includes the contact owner
moduleContractTests.rationale: Maintains CRM contact-owner preference while preserving fallback fairness candidates.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When routing does not produce a single host and fairness filtering is applicable, qualified hosts are the fairness-filtered candidates.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the ordering of routed-member selection before lead-threshold fairness.
